Pure elemental bcc vanadium, not V oxide or a multiphase sample aggregate. The separately sourced 298.15 K diffraction cell (27.6559412875 A^3) differs from the Crichton relaxed-foil EOS reference (27.995 A^3); retain both reported conventions. Advent foil sample purity is not quantified in the EOS manuscript.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Thermal equation choices</summary>

- **Thermal expansion law:** linear\_temperature
- **Reference volume law:** integrated\_expansivity
- **Bulk modulus law:** linear\_temperature

</details>

Source-owned unconstrained 62-point unweighted fit, measured to 11.5 GPa and 1000 K. Initial first-cycle stressed-foil observations were anomalous; recovered ambient point is explicitly excluded. No statistical confidence/covariance is specified. Nominal-temperature digitized symbols only support a qualified proxy refit, not the original regression. The source Conclusion quotes 2.7% ambient and 1.2% at 10 GPa expansion from 300 to 1000 K; stored coefficients give 2.294% and 1.026%. Figure 2 supports the stored expansion convention; no coefficient is changed to force the prose values. Two fixed-K0-prime alternatives are withheld for missing V0 and thermal parameters.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Accepted manuscript pp.4-7: Experimental, Results, Conclusion; Accepted manuscript p.11: Figure 2; Publisher abstract (21 January 2016); Angel et al. (2014), pp.410, 412: earlier EosFit expansion and K(T) conventions.
- **V0:** Results p.5: unconstrained relative reference volume 1.005(1), equal to independently recovered 1.005 = 27.995 A^3; Figure 2 caption confirms equality. Conventional bcc cell, Z=2. Absolute fitted-volume uncertainty is not explicitly printed; retain ratio error separately.
- **K0:** Results p.5, unconstrained 62-point unweighted fit: 150.4 +/-6.2 GPa.
- **K0 prime:** Results p.5: 5.5(10), fitted; constant with T in EosFit5 convention.
- **Alpha0:** Results p.5: 4.8(6)e-5 K^-1, fitted intercept at T=0 in alpha(T)=alpha0+alpha1\*T, NOT alpha(300 K).
- **Alpha1:** Results p.5: -2.4(9)e-8 K^-2, fitted.
- **Dk dt:** Results p.5: -0.0446(7) GPa/K, fitted slope of K0(T) at zero pressure, not derivative of K0-prime.
- **Tr:** Experimental p.4 and K0,300 label: 300 K.
- **Equation:** BM3; EOS-FIT5.2 (Angel 2002) with linear alpha(T); Angel et al. 2014 doi:10.1515/zkri-2013-1711 p.410 explicitly documents earlier EosFit exponential integral of alpha0+alpha1\*T, p.412 linear K0(T).

</details>
